_comment: Copy to hooks/guardrails.json and edit. Anything omitted falls back to the built-in defaults in guard.py.

extra_rules.message: terraform destroy from an agent: run it yourself.
full-upgrade breaks dpkg in a PRoot/chroot environment (hardlinks). Upgrade single packages instead.
a manual getUpdates steals the poll from a bot that already has one, and takes that service down with a 409. Read its logs or its database instead.
